scope: input integrity and sparse loader only; no cell QC, embedding or biological inference
historical_runtime: runtime/ is preserved historical provenance; its Git-less image must not execute this job

download.selection: Only the nine exact regular-file basenames in config/inputs.json; reject duplicate selected names, links, traversal, size or hash mismatch. Preserve the complete downloaded archive.

container.nonroot_user: existing source owner UID/GID; never root
container.output: one fresh allocated parent mounted at analysis/research/runs; runner creates unique p001_metadata_v1_<attempt> directory

before_dispatch: exact committed frozen contract and source hashes
one authoritative coordinator ledger with unique attempt and immutable packet
verified private checkpoint and source/packet recovery material
reviewed-job receipt bound to actual contract hash
after_run: verify unchanged Ravel receipt and every declared output
verify container exit/OOM state, PID zero and captured process identities absent
hash and privately export full outputs/logs plus packet/source bindings; verify downloaded bytes
memory_review: Record per-library loader peak RSS and available cgroup peak separately. Root must review actual values before freezing the separate descriptive stage; no automatic pass or parameter rescue.
failure: Retain failed attempt, logs and source. No automatic retry, ledger slot release, threshold change or Figure 1 dispatch.
